annotations.title: Everything needed to fix an incident

description: One structured brief for fixing an incident without asking a person: the incident (summary, severity, first and last seen, state and who has it), the source and target that raised it (their config, with every credential left as the env-var NAME and never a value), the predicates the rule cell asserts and which one the last run failed, `discovered.foundAt`/`read` (where the endpoint was found in the project and what was read there), the last good observation beside the last bad one (bodies cut), a `reproduce` block with the exact curl/nc/command that re-runs the check locally, the other open incidents on the same service, the evidence links the source offers (a Sentry permalink and culprit, a Netdata chart, Grafana panel links), and `next`: fix, restart/deploy, then verify_fix. Reads only; start here when you are about to fix something rather than triage it.

key.description: The incident key exactly as watch_state or list_incidents print it ("<service>|<rule>", or "<service>|<rule>|<instance>" for a rule split per instance). Not an alert key.
